Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Mount Laurel for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (card making at the library, the Evesham Holiday Light Parade and the Medford Dickens Festival) through December 19, with the Moorestown Miracle on Main Street (December 6) and the Mount Laurel tree lighting with Santa on a fire truck (December 7) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Mount Laurel

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Mount Laurel and nearby Marlton, Moorestown and Medford
  • 4 free events: Holiday Card Making, the Mount Laurel tree lighting, the Evesham Holiday Light Parade and the Medford Dickens Festival
  • Meet Santa: Santa on a fire truck at the Mount Laurel tree lighting (December 7) and Miracle on Main Street in Moorestown (December 6)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Evesham Holiday Light Parade (December 5) and the Mount Laurel tree and menorah lighting (December 7)
  • Season: December 5 to 19
